settings.fixed: current mask, directional hold, original effective paper applied, original fine-L field
settings.change: colour only: withhold qualified known paper within3/6px of effective applied, solve in this virtual region too
settings.virtual: original effective applied OR (old known-paper AND outside distance<=radius)
settings.references: old known-paper minus virtual; no newly qualified pixels
settings.numerical: same raw/sigma6 known-only smooth4-neighbour harmonic solver, min area64 and16 adjacent pairs
settings.physical_update: virtual solver accepted AND original effective applied only; preserve old baseline elsewhere
settings.composition: new raw/smooth colour boundary mix uses original effective applied distance8; baseline float field plus new-minus-old colour
settings.control: radius0 re-solves same original paper reference; must reproduce baseline at all90ROIs
settings.texture_reference: original old known-paper/fine-L unchanged; distinct from newly withheld colour references
settings.virtual_caveat: withheld old-qualified paper is numerical unknown only, never a new physical edit or damage classification
settings.unsupported: retain original baseline; do not add applied pixels
